correctness.rationale: The root-one residue uniquely identifies the polynomial part. Pairwise coprime denominators give simple disjoint nontrivial poles; orthogonal Fourier supports eliminate cross terms on the full product period. Parseval reduces to pure and doubled-angle cosecant moments; the latter is evaluated exactly using csc^2(x)csc^2(2x)=(csc^4(x)+csc^2(x)+sec^2(x))/4 and multiplication identities valid at every odd modulus. The a=1 empty root sum is consistent. An independently implemented exact-rational coefficient DP confirms all 66 tested finite configurations, but the universal conclusion follows from the proof.
